item.title: Crafting a Referral Request ✨ • Identify the right contact within the company. • Personalize your message with shared interests. • Clearly state your interest in the company. • Ask politely for a referral or introduction. • Offer to reciprocate in the future. 🤝 How can you make your referral request more compelling and personalized? #networking #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
